thread:
Ava Ruiz: Quick sync on the Orbit launch email flow. Goal: 3-touch nurture + webinar invite, but with a lighter path for cold users. Draft here: https://drive.redwood.ai/orbit-launch-v3
Sanjay Patel: Good plan. Question: treat webinar registrants as a separate funnel so they get reminder cadence?@Marta
Marta Chen: Yes — webinar registrants get their own reminders and are suppressed from the general nurture once registered. Non-registrants receive nurture that culminates with an invite CTA.
Leo Novak: Propose splitting non-registrants into active vs cold. Active = opened or clicked in last 30d; cold = otherwise. Different subject lines and send frequency.
Ben Ortiz: SQL for segments I sketched:
```
-- active-engagers
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE last_engagement_at > now() - interval '30 days' AND email_opt_in = true;
-- cold
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE last_engagement_at <= now() - interval '30 days' AND email_opt_in = true;
```
Sanjay Patel: Tracking params: utm_medium=email&utm_source=orbit&utm_campaign=orbit_launch_v1 and add header X-Redwood-Mail: orbit-launch.
Ava Ruiz: Subject A/B ideas:
A) "See how Redwood cuts inference cost by 3x — live demo"
B) "Reduce LLM latency and cost — webinar + 3 quick wins"
Keep it technical + outcome driven.
Marta Chen: Cold cohort gets a 2-email, softer copy. Active gets 3 emails plus webinar invite 48h prior.
Leo Novak: Send windows: 10am local primary, 4pm local backup; test different windows for APAC/EU/NA. Stagger sends to smooth throughput.
Ben Ortiz: Ops check: do we have send throttle in Dedicated? @deploy-bot can you share current throttle config?
deploy-bot: Marketing batch throttle: 2500 msgs/min per region, burst 5000 for 10m. See ops doc: https://ops.redwood.ai/batch-throttle
Sanjay Patel: Targets for launch week: open rate 20% baseline, CTR 3.5%, webinar sign rate 6% for active. Monitor via Looker dashboard marketing.orbit.launch_v1.
Ava Ruiz: CTAs: primary = "Join the demo" (web), secondary for cold = "Learn how" (docs). Use concise preheader for mobile.
Marta Chen: Suppress anyone who started a trial in last 90 days, unsubscribed users, and recent webinar attendees.
Leo Novak: Copy should include one benchmark stat + one customer quote. That lifted conversion last time.
Ben Ortiz: I'll build the HTML template with dynamic blocks for region/time/webinar link. ETA EOD Friday, then a 100-recipient smoke test.
Ava Ruiz: Action list:
- Ben: template + staging send (EOD Fri)
- Sanjay: finalize segments & export (tomorrow AM)
- Marta: finalize copy & subjects (tomorrow noon)
- Leo: finalize send windows & throttling notes (tomorrow)
- Ava: configure Looker alerts for launch week
Everyone: add test recipients to the doc and tag me when ready for test blasts. :thumbsup:
Sanjay Patel: Added dev+pm+ops to the test sheet.
Ben Ortiz: Will run smoke test after staging deploy and ping @Ava.
Marta Chen: Copy v3 is in the doc with two subject variants for active.
Ava Ruiz: Final go/no-go check Monday AM. Thanks team! :rocket:
